dimensions.assessment: Applies to all institutions of higher education participating in federal student aid and their enrolled or prospective students.
dimensions.evidence: Each institution of higher education participating in any program under this title shall carry out the information dissemination activities

dimensions.assessment: Requires administrative information-sharing (emails, handbooks, websites) rather than altering substantive educational services.
dimensions.evidence: information dissemination activities described in this paragraph shall include an email to each enrolled student at least once each academic year

dimensions.assessment: No federal funding changes or direct economic costs are stated in the source text.
Amends section 485 of the Higher Education Act of 1965 to add specific disclosure mandates.
dimensions.evidence: Section 485 of the Higher Education Act of 1965 (20 U.S.C. 1092) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent nationwide compliance requirement for covered colleges and universities.

importance_detail.rationale: Requires institutions of higher education participating in federal student aid programs to regularly distribute specific information and resource details to students regarding pregnancy rights.
